member.name: T:Neurotec.Biometrics.Tools.NFClassifier
member.remarks:
The functionality of the NFClassifier can be accessed from the Neurotec.Biometrics.NFClassifier.dll which is a wrapper of the NFClassifier.dll.
NFClassifier can classify into one of the following pattern classes: Left slant loop, Right slant loop, Scar, Tented arch, Whorl and Plain arch. If NFClassifier failed to determine pattern class Unknown pattern class is assigned.
